safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the patient specifically tried E45 and antihistamines removes useful treatment-history detail and may lead to redundant recommendations or missing that itch management has already been attempted. However, it is unlikely to cause major harm because the core diagnosis/work-up and first-line management (avoid irritants, emollients, topical steroid) would not substantially change.
